about.title: About us
about.lead: Supsto is a B2B trade platform that speeds up the commercial connection between suppliers and buyers.

sections.title: Vision
sections.body: Matching the right product with the right supplier in the shortest time.

sections.title: Approach
sections.body: Optimising discovery, communication, RFQs and quoting before the classic B2C cart and checkout model.

sections.title: From Türkiye to global
sections.body: The first phase focuses on Türkiye, then evolves into multi-country and multi-currency support.

sections.title: Trust
sections.body: Transparency through on-site verification and supplier performance signals.

how-it-works.title: How it works
how-it-works.lead: The core flow on Supsto: find → review → get in touch → collect quotes → agree.

sections.title: 1. Search products
sections.body: Start exploring by product, category, city or supplier.

sections.title: 2. Review the supplier
sections.body: Compare MOQ, stock, price tiers and verification signals.

sections.title: 3. Post an RFQ
sections.body: Publish your bulk requirement and build a pool of quotes.

sections.title: 4. Manage quotes
sections.body: Compare them and accept the one that fits.

sections.title: Product discovery

sections.title: RFQ

sections.title: Quote comparison

sections.title: Price integrity
sections.body: Nobody can alter a supplier’s quoted price afterwards — guaranteed at the database level.

for-suppliers.title: For suppliers

sections.title: RFQ opportunities
sections.body: Filter the requirements that fit you and submit quotes.

sections.title: On-site verification
sections.body: Use the verification badge as a trust signal.

sections.title: Quote integrity
sections.body: Only you can change your quoted price; the buyer can only accept or reject.

verification.title: On-site verification
verification.lead: The supplier badge verified by the Supsto field team.

sections.title: What does it mean?
sections.body: A trust mark for company profiles that passed a Supsto field check.

sections.title: Who can grant it?
sections.body: Only an authorised Supsto administrator. Companies cannot grant it to themselves; the rule is enforced by a database trigger.

sections.title: What does it cover?
sections.body: Company details, a site visit and basic commercial existence checks.

sections.title: Why it matters
sections.body: A trust signal for buyers, a visibility advantage for suppliers.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: The questions we hear most about Supsto.

sections.title: Is Supsto a payment provider?
sections.body: No. There is no classic B2C cart or checkout step; the platform focuses on communication and quoting.

sections.title: What is an RFQ?
sections.body: A buyer publishing a bulk requirement and collecting quotes from many suppliers.

sections.title: What is MOQ?
sections.body: Minimum order quantity — the smallest order a supplier will accept.

sections.title: Can I hide my price?
sections.body: Yes. You can hide the price per product and share it only through a quote.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: Rules for using the platform and for commercial interaction.

sections.title: The platform’s role
sections.body: Supsto is a technology platform connecting buyers and suppliers; it is not a party to the contract between them.

sections.title: Content responsibility
sections.body: Whoever publishes the content is responsible for the accuracy of product, price and company information.

sections.title: RFQ rules
sections.body: Requests for quotation must relate to genuine commercial needs.

sections.title: Account security
sections.body: The user is responsible for protecting their account credentials.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: How personal data is processed and protected.

sections.title: Data use
sections.body: We process the data required for account, company and platform activity.

sections.title: Profile visibility
sections.body: Your phone number and profile details are not public; only you and authorised administrators can access them.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.body: Anonymous measurements may be used for platform performance.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Data subject rights are supported in line with applicable law.

kvkk.title: KVKK
kvkk.lead: The personal data protection framework in Türkiye.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: The legal entity operating Supsto acts as the data controller.

sections.title: Purposes
sections.body: Service delivery, account security and communication between parties.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Data is retained only as long as necessary for its purpose.

sections.title: Requests
sections.body: You can use the support channel for KVKK requests.
